description: The analysis steps a document can go through, and for a given set of documents HOW MANY each step would actually touch — the number that belongs on the button. Optional: document_ids (to get the counts), entity + entity_id (all documents of one record). Steps that are catalogued but not built say so instead of quietly missing; a step blocked on every document reports 0 rather than looking available.

entity.description: Record type whose documents to count, used with entity_id

name: list_document_steps
